game.name: Ben 10 Omniverse (USA)
game.desc: Ben 10 Omniverse is a beat'em all for Xbox 360. Following a failed experiment, the space-time continuum is deregulated and Korbo travels between two eras. Allied to a Ben 10 who is sometimes a child and sometimes a teenager, they must both defeat numerous enemies. New combos and additional powers are unlocked by gaining experience.
